svg.text: Local software preview and source regression · no deployment or hardware acceptance
• Focused GLB regression passed: all 7 tooth nodes use #89969a; 4 representative painted parts
• Construction-equipment ESLint passed; kit quality gate: 60/60 assets (100%).
• Generated index rebuild passed; source SHA matches and the existing preview path is present.
• Full catalog integration passed: 151 files and 221 tests, including index freshness.
• Global quality gate reports 2,398/2,402 assets (99.83%); 4 thin assets remain in
816 triangles unchanged · default preview unchanged because the teeth are occluded
